mapping.collapsing11to5: Deliberate. The wet grid needs to know what sheds water and what holds it, not what the crop is. Scenario comparisons stay valid because every scenario reads the same grid.
mapping.croplandApproximation: ESA cropland (40) and built-up (50) are both mapped to 'paved'. They differ in hydrology; HSK/HT is post-reclamation so cropland there is mostly formed land awaiting development, but this is a compromise and is recorded rather than hidden.

grid.crs: EPSG:4326 on the wire; local equirectangular for measurement

caveats: WorldCover is a 2021 single-epoch product; it does not show change since then, which is a real gap for a study area under construction.
10 m source resampled to the 5 m analysis grid, so it adds no detail below 10 m -- it is not an error to treat the 5 m land class as really 10 m.
ESA codes are modelled classifications, not ground truth.
